title: Later reading sessions replace earlier page totals
description: The book-club summary currently loses earlier sessions for a title. Repair reading_totals(records) while preserving exact title identity and the order in which titles first appear.

requirements.text: reading_totals(records) returns one {"book": title, "pages": sum} record for each distinct exact book string, ordered by first occurrence. Sum all page counts for that string. Title matching is case-sensitive and performs no trimming or Unicode normalization. Empty strings and zero totals remain represented. Empty input returns [].
The supplied records list and every record dictionary must remain unchanged on successful returns and ValueError paths, including duplicate-title aggregation.

records must be a list of dictionaries with exactly the keys "book" and "pages". book must be a string, with any Unicode content including an empty string allowed. pages must be a plain integer from 0 through 1000000 inclusive. Any invalid outer value, entry, key set, title type or page value (including booleans, floats and null) raises ValueError.
